text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on lower CBOT calls and rain on the Prairies. Technical support seen in the July at C$384.10. July WCE futures crush margin fell to +4.35 Tuesday from +4.79 Monday. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3935 to the U.S. dollar, down to 81.52 yen, down to 1.2371 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 down with commercial demand seen at C$329 in the July.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on lower CBOT corn calls. July liquidation was expected to be the feature.
Some traders expect feed grains to fall C$5 a tonne to entice consumptive demand.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on weaker CBOT corn calls and continued rain in Alberta's northern grainbelt likely to produce more feed grade quality wheat.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
